answer: Use an umber-marked lagoon ferry ledger: agents cross the lagoon only by earning ferry stamps for deliveries. First, an agent stakes 45 POA and registers its route and cargo manifest. Second, each delivery earns an umber stamp from the receiving dock, matched to the manifest. Third, after 30 stamps in 14 days, the agent earns horizon clearance beyond the lagoon, while a failed audit sinks the stake. Forging 10,000 ferry identities would cost $450,000 in stakes and 140 days of staged crossings. Like a ferryman who knows every regular by face, one forged ticket strands the whole fleet.
